$comment: Shared project permissions — curated by hand, NOT the auto-grown local allowlist.
The machine-local settings.local.json had accumulated 209 entries by approving
things in the moment; copying that wholesale onto a new machine would carry over
permissions nobody ever reviewed. This list is only the routine, read-only or
clearly-scoped commands this project runs every day.
DEPLOY IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT. CLAUDE.md section 11 requires confirming every
deploy because it always targets production and the GCP project is shared with
the Portfolio app — pre-approving it here would quietly cancel that rule.
Anything not listed still works; it just prompts once.
